name: Connecteam
summary: All-in-one app for managing deskless teams. Scheduling, time clock, tasks, training and team chat for hourly and frontline workforces.
best_for: deskless and frontline teams (shift work, field crews) that need scheduling, a time clock and comms in one app, on the free-for-10 plan
skip_if: your whole team sits at desks with email and Slack — this is built for the frontline, and a general PM tool fits an office better
honest_knock: The free-for-10 plan is one of the most generous in the category, but the three-hub structure means costs can stack if you need all of them — price the specific hubs you'll actually use, not the full bundle. Read two terms before paying: a monthly plan can be cancelled at any time but prepaid amounts are not refunded, and an annual plan is refundable pro rata only within its first 30 days. Every price is in US dollars, with no other currency offered.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed yearly ($35 monthly), covers first 30 users
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 on their own pricing page, USD) The free tier is real and not a trial: the Small Business Plan is $0 for life, covers up to 10 users and includes all hubs and features. Above that you buy per hub — Operations, Communications or HR & Skills — and each hub carries a flat base price covering the first 30 users, plus a per-user surcharge only from user 31 onward. Billed yearly that base is $29/mo at Basic, $49 at Advanced and $99 at Expert; billed monthly it is $35, $59 and $119. The surcharge is where the hubs diverge: on the yearly plans Operations adds $0.80, $2.50 and $4.20 per extra user a month, while Communications and HR & Skills add $0.50, $1.50 and $3.00. Quoting only the per-user rate understates a small team's bill, because a shop of 30 or fewer pays the flat base either way. Price it per hub you will actually switch on, not per user. Re-read on 3 October 2026 with every figure unchanged; the yearly toggle is now labelled "save 18%", and the 14-day trial still needs no credit card. Re-read on 22 October 2026 by plain fetch with every base price and surcharge unchanged. The page's FAQ adds two terms that change the free-tier picture: a team of 11 to 30 users does not have to pay after the trial, because it can move to the Limited plan, free for life on each hub but keeping only the essentials; and the time-clock comparison table marks payroll integration as not included in the Small Business Plan. Prices are in US dollars only.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 29 October 2026: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We switched on Quick Tasks, saved two made-up tasks with an attachment as drafts, exported the task list and looked at the plans.
findings: The pricing page offers a '14-day free trial', but our account landed on the Small Business plan instead: 'FREE for small businesses with up to 10 employees … Free for life'. No card was asked.

Setup asks for company size and industry, then a mobile number; you cannot reach the dashboard without one. Your industry decides which tools appear: Quick Tasks was not in our menu until we added it.
Connecteam adds two sample users ('Liz (sample)', 'Sam (sample)') and, when you switch on Quick Tasks, two example tasks. A task must be assigned to someone, even as a draft.
The task export (XLSX) included all four drafts. Our description lost its line break, and accents were kept. There is no task ID.
The attachments came back as links to public.cdn.connecteam.com that open without logging in; the downloaded files were byte-for-byte the same as our uploads.
'Add multiple tasks' is a grid for new tasks, not a file import, so there is no way to update tasks by importing a file.
Paid plans are priced per hub (Operations, Communications, HR & Skills): Basic $29, Advanced $49 and Expert $99 a month billed yearly, each up to 10 users.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
